WHERE d.status IN ('FAILED_PERMANENT', 'SENT')
      AND (d.failure_reason = ANY($2::text[]) OR d.status = 'SENT')
      AND d.updated_at >= $3::timestamptz AND d.updated_at < $4::timestamptz
      AND ($5::text IS NULL OR d.channel = $5::text)
      AND ($6::bigint IS NULL OR d.account_id = $6::bigint)
      AND ($7::text[] IS NULL OR i.type = ANY($7::text[]))
    ORDER BY d.updated_at, d.id
    LIMIT $8
    FOR UPDATE OF d SKIP LOCKED
)
UPDATE notification.deliveries d
SET status = 'PENDING', failure_reason = NULL, updated_at = $1::timestamptz
FROM picked
WHERE d.id = picked.id
mutants.why: Resend selects SENT deliveries too, so an already succeeded delivery would be reset and sent twice.

mutants.old:
JOIN notification.intents i ON i.id = d.intent_id
    WHERE i.created_at >= $1::timestamptz
mutants.new:
JOIN notification.intents i ON i.id = d.intent_id
    WHERE i.created_at >= $1::timestamptz AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM notification.inbox_items x WHERE x.account_id = d.account_id AND x.audience = d.audience)
mutants.why: The unreached count treats a recipient with an inbox row as reached although the inbox is not a channel.
